analyst_view.overall: Sunderland (11th, 7 pts) host Jagiellonia (29th, 3 pts) needing a win to stay in the play-off places, after a 2-0 home defeat to Dinamo Zagreb last time in Europe. They drew 0-0 at Aston Villa on Saturday but are still in the Premier League bottom three and host Tottenham on Sunday, so changes are likely. Granit Xhaka (calf, no return date), Brian Brobbey (thigh), Daniel Ballard, Romaine Mundle and Habib Diarra are out and Trai Hume is banned for three yellows; the numbers count Brobbey (about -23% on Sunderland's goals) and Diarra but not Xhaka, Hume or rotation. Jagiellonia have lost three of four in Europe, lost 3-1 at Cracovia at the weekend, are without captain Taras Romanczuk (three yellows) and their fans are barred from travelling. Bulgarian referee Georgi Kabakov (about 4.6 cards a game) is in charge.

goals.text: The numbers say 2.2 goals and already take a big slice off Sunderland for Brobbey, with their recent scoring (3 in six) also counted. Xhaka's absence and likely rotation before Spurs are not in the numbers, so I trim a little, to about 2.1; Jagiellonia losing Romanczuk in midfield keeps the cut small.

corners.text: The numbers say 9.6 corners, 7.2 for Sunderland, already a little lower for their recent corner count. Without Xhaka and right-back Hume, and with changes likely, Sunderland's pressure from wide areas should be a bit lighter, so I go to about 9.3.

cards.text: The numbers say 4.4 cards, already raised for both sides' recent bookings and for referee Georgi Kabakov's above-average record (4.6 a game). Romanczuk and Hume, two players who reached three yellows, are out, but that is too small to move, so I stay at 4.4.

shots.text: The numbers say 28.5 shots, mostly Sunderland (21.3), already up about 8% for their recent shooting. Rotation with Spurs three days later and no Xhaka to set the tempo should trim that a little, so I go to about 27.4.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 9.9 shots on target, with Brobbey's absence already taken off the goal figure. A rotated attack around Wilson Isidor should be slightly less sharp, so I go to about 9.6.
